description: Customer access to the Crown Town Compost portal: pickups, invoices, and skips (AI-built).
name: io.github.chrischall/crowntowncompost-mcp

environmentVariables.description: A Cookie header from an already-signed-in portal session ("sessionid=...; csrftoken=..."). Supply this and no password is needed — the login is skipped entirely.
environmentVariables.name: CROWNTOWN_SESSION_COOKIE

environmentVariables.description: Your portal.crowntowncompost.com username or email address. Needed only if you are not supplying CROWNTOWN_SESSION_COOKIE.
environmentVariables.name: CROWNTOWN_USERNAME

environmentVariables.description: Your Crown Town Compost customer-portal password. Needed only if you are not supplying CROWNTOWN_SESSION_COOKIE.
environmentVariables.name: CROWNTOWN_PASSWORD

environmentVariables.description: Set to false to disable the on-disk session cache and re-authenticate on every process start. Defaults to enabled.
environmentVariables.name: CROWNTOWN_SESSION_CACHE

environmentVariables.description: Absolute path for the session cache file. Defaults to $MCP_DATA_DIR/.crowntowncompost-mcp/session.json.
environmentVariables.name: CROWNTOWN_SESSION_FILE
